children: India is likely to extend an export ​incentive programme, called ⁠the Remission ​of Duties and ​Taxes on Export Products, for exporters for five years beyond its scheduled end on September 30, a government trade source said on Wednesday.

The commerce ministry sought 230 billion rupees ($2.40 billion) from the finance ministry under the programme for 2026/27, a trade ministry official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, told reporters.
